skill.name: LangChain
skill.description: Avoid common LangChain mistakes — LCEL gotchas, memory persistence, RAG chunking, and output parser traps.
skill.summary: LCEL Basics - `|` pipes output to next — `prompt | llm | parser` - `RunnablePassthrough()` forwards input unchanged — use in parallel branches - `RunnableParallel` runs branches concurrently — `{"a": chain1, "b": chain2}
